map.根据末次月经(LMP)及早期B超(CRL/双顶径)推算并校正孕周与预产期: Estimate and correct gestational age and due date from the last menstrual period (LMP) and early ultrasound (CRL/biparietal diameter)
map.孕周 = 末次月经(LMP) + 280 天 或 超声径线校正；周期长度调整预产: Gestational age = last menstrual period (LMP) + 280 days, or corrected by ultrasound measurements; cycle length adjusts the due date
map.结合 LMP 与超声测量重新确定孕周，周期差调整预产期（周期超过 28 天后延/: Redetermine gestational age by combining LMP and ultrasound measurements, and adjust the due date for cycle difference (shift later/earlier for cycles over 28 days).
map.按 LMP 或早孕期超声（CRL/BPD）推算当前孕周与 EDD。: Estimate current gestational age and EDD from LMP or first-trimester ultrasound (CRL/BPD).
map.LMP 不清时以超声孕周为准。: When LMP is unclear, the ultrasound gestational age governs.
map.核对末次月经与超声孕周差异。: Check the difference between the last menstrual period and the ultrasound gestational age.

map.CRL 和 LMP 哪个准？: Which is more accurate, CRL or LMP?
map.孕 7–13 周 CRL 推算最准（误差 ±5–7 天），优先于 LMP；>14: CRL is most accurate at 7-13 weeks (error +/-5-7 days) and takes priority over LMP; after 14 weeks the error of BPD/HC and others grows.
map.两者差多少要校正？: How big a difference requires correction?
map.一般相差 >7 天（早孕期）或 >10–14 天（中晚孕）时以超声校正预产期。: Generally when the difference is >7 days (first trimester) or >10-14 days (second and third trimesters), the due date is corrected by ultrasound.
